lock_min_note: halfbeat.blend_check abstains below 4 drum-on-drum bars. Among 19/33 protrans pro windows with dd>=4, p05=9.8; using 10 as a floor would veto passing rides with 5-9 overlap bars, so the lock's own floor of 4 is the one we use.
lock_rule: reject a ride when a near-half-beat residual is measured on grid-aligned source bars (both faded decks > -35 dB) and drum-on-drum bars < lock_min_dd
thin_cohort: protrans official pro windows (n=33), st bar[all] vs drop median, outgoing in breakdown and incoming not in a drop and both <= -thin_db vs drop
pump_note: source x equal-power fade under-predicted __23 (3.66 vs 4.82) because FADE=long uses fade_long.xlong (a mid shelf near 0.45–0.50), not a linear equal-power ramp. xlong prediction is 4.18, still under 4.54, and over-predicts passing __12 (4.62 vs 2.9). The both-thin gate is the calibrated substitute.
